title: Jobs linked from tickets and bugs that still have their log
compared: Public jobs that tickets and bugs link to, and whether each job and its autoinst-log.txt could still be read.
sample: Recent test-issue and infrastructure tickets of the public tracker and recent product bugs, each linked job checked once.
verdict: 119 of 130 linked jobs still had their log, but only 3 infrastructure tickets linked a job at all, and 54 of the jobs with a log had failed.
note: A job linked from a ticket gets a label:linked comment, which keeps it from cleanup; the check here is whether the log could still be read. The other linked jobs with a log had passed or soft-failed. The failed ones with a log were the first trial set.
